content: WebAuthn RP ID must be the exact hostname or a registrable parent domain (eTLD+1 or higher), never on the Public Suffix List. Best practice is to set RP ID to the apex/root domain so credentials work across all subdomains; changing RP ID later invalidates all existing passkeys (except when narrowing to a subdomain, or via Related Origin Requests / .well-known/webauthn). For multi-tenant SaaS at tenant.app.example.com, set RP ID to app.example.com (a single static value) so passkeys work across all tenant subdomains.
